answer.rationale: Finance mandates an 18% component spend reduction; incumbent refusal to reopen price this cycle blocks the renewal path. Memory_c2 demonstrates that a prior switch to a low-cost primary vendor delivered sharp unit-cost cuts with fast, accurate onboarding. Given the 14-day expiry and 94% line utilization with no buffer, supply continuity is non-negotiable; memory_c2’s proven transition suggests manageable risk. Alternative actions fail: renewal (memory_c1) preserves integration but cannot meet the cost target, negotiation (memory_c4) is already rejected, adding a second source (memory_c3) addresses risk but not the 18% cut, and deferral (memory_c5) risks a supply gap. Multi-year commitments (memory_c6) are infeasible with the current refusal.
